requirements.requirement: The system must produce a higher relevance score for exact condition matches than for partial matches in unit tests.
The system must produce a non-zero but lower relevance score for partial condition matches compared to exact matches.
The system must return a relevance score of zero when no trial conditions match the user condition intent.
The system must normalize all relevance scores to a consistent bounded range (e.g., 0 to 1) in unit tests.
The system must include contributing factors or explanation fields in the scoring output during unit tests.
The system must validate that synonym-based matches yield a relevance score greater than zero in unit tests.
The system must return deterministic relevance scores for identical inputs across repeated test runs.
The system must include a relevance_score field in each clinical trial object returned by the clinical_trials_service in integration tests.
The system must preserve existing clinical trial response fields while adding relevance_score during integration tests.
The system must successfully execute integration tests where multiple trials are returned and each contains an independently computed relevance score.
The system must handle empty or null user condition input by returning a relevance score of zero without throwing an exception.
The system must handle missing or empty trial condition lists by returning a relevance score of zero without failing the service response.
The system must raise a controlled and testable error when the scoring logic receives malformed input structures that violate the schema.
The system must verify that integration responses from evaluate_care_facade include the relevance_score field consistent with clinical_trials_service outputs.
